text:
priya: Quick sync 16: we need a new intake pattern for the next Design Partner run. weekly cohorts felt too big; thinking micro-batches + paired office-hours. thoughts?
lee: micro-batches = smaller feedback loops. what size were you thinking?
priya: 6 partners every 3 days, run for 3 cycles = 18 total. keeps dev context tight and lets us act on feedback between cycles.
anton: +1. also propose pairing one eng PM per micro-batch for a 30m office-hour slot on day 2 so partners can show flows. that increases qualitative signal.
nora: agree. need to be explicit about prep: partners must upload a one-paragraph use-case and one representative prompt before office-hour. otherwise demos are noise.
priya: yes 10 prompt-set + expected outputs. we'll capture baseline model output during onboarding.
trent: measurement: acceptance rate target 65%+, 2-cycle retention target 80%+, and actioned bugs >= 3 per cycle (to measure signal). also track "fast fixes" (<=48h).
lee: how do we score feedback? freeform is messy. can we borrow a 1-5 impact x ease rubric? e.g., impact 1-5, effort 1-5, and tag feature/regression/ux.
anton: that works. add a "must-fix" boolean for anything blocking partner integration.
nora: operationally: automation rules: on offer send, wait 48h for accept; if no accept, send SMS/email reminder; if no response 72h, move to warm pool with "2-week hold". that reduces ghosting.
priya: for incentives: small credit + invite to "first-look" changelog demo. keeps them engaged.
lee: we should also schedule a short async checklist: run the canned prompt-set (copy attached) and paste outputs to the form. that will let SRE/ML triage early.
anton: escalation: if 2+ partners flag quality regression within a 24h window, auto-open a "pilot-incident" in pager and pause new micro-batch offers until triage ok. can we wire that into Console alerts?
trent: yes 10 I'll add a metric: partner-reported-regressions / 24h and a console tile with a pause toggle.
nora: who owns the invite template + automations?
priya: I can draft invite language and intake form. lee: you own the automation rules?
lee: yep. I'll stub RT rules: reminders, warm pool tagging, auto-invite from warm pool when new batch opens.
trent: I'll own dashboard + alert tiles. anton: onboarding office-hour slots + eng pairing?
anton: I'll coordinate with eng rotations and create a 3-day oncall for pilot pairing.
nora: I'll write the partner prep checklist and prompt-set gate. will include examples and a short "how to screen outputs" rubric.
priya: timeline: draft invite & form by Thurs EOD, automations stub by Fri, dashboard mock by next Tue, dry-run micro-batch next Wed.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Micro-batch Pilot Dry Run" Thu 09:00 10 attendees: priya, lee, anton, nora, trent.
lee: small copy suggestion for invite: "We run 3-day micro-batches. Accept within 48h to hold your slot. Expect one 30m office-hour during the batch and ~30min/week of participation."
priya: good. also add "we may pause new invites if quality issues are detected" to set expectations.
anton: final ask: make sure SRE has a simple triage path: partner report -> triage doc -> severity -> rollback/canary -> postmortem. nora 10 add link to triage doc in intake form.
nora: will do. I'll publish the checklist and triage doc links in this thread once ready.
trent: ok owners recap: priya (invite + intake), lee (automation), anton (eng pairing + oncall), nora (checklist + triage doc), trent (dashboard + alerts).
priya: thanks all. small follow-ups: 1) priya posts invite copy, 2) lee shares automation RFC, 3) nora posts prompt-set gate, 4) trent shares dashboard mock. aim to close by Fri.
lee: will add the automation RFC link here when ready.
ops-bot: Reminder set: "Pilot micro-batch prep review" Mon 10:00 10 attendees: priya, lee, anton, nora, trent.
priya: cool. let's keep feedback in #pilot-feedback and summarize weekly here. thanks everyone. :party_popper:
